title: GPT-4 Turbo CS1 Python exercise bank
summary: A generated bank of 11,700 Python exercises spans 78 CS1 subtopics, three difficulty levels, and coding, Parsons, troubleshooting, multiple-choice, and fill-in-the-blank formats. Students and instructors evaluated sampled items for difficulty, relevance, hint usefulness, and overall quality before proposed use on coding platforms.

sources.title: Human Evaluation of GPT for Scalable Python Programming Exercise Generation
sources.evidence_quote: We generated a total of 11,700 exercises across five types and three levels of difficulty

assessment.summary: Complete generated Python exercises selected by topic, subtopic, format, and easy, medium, or hard difficulty.
student_actions: Write Python code, arrange Parsons blocks, troubleshoot erroneous code, choose MCQ answers, or fill blanks.

student_role.description: GPT-4 Turbo generates the exercise bank; the proposed learner role is to solve curated exercises rather than interact with the model.

assessment_system_role: Generate exercises, solutions, test cases, and hints
